clubs.name: Student Discipline Club
clubs.description: NIT Hamirpur's cultural-activities page lists Discipline Club among its key clubs. An official Dean Student Welfare notice dated 2026-10-01 establishes office bearers for the Student Discipline Club for session 2026-2027 and states that their duties are governed by institute rules, regulations, guidelines and competent-authority directions.
uncertainties: The institute's general club list uses the shorter name 'Discipline Club'; the October 2026 notice uses 'Student Discipline Club'.
Student office-bearer names and roll numbers in the source PDF are intentionally not imported.

notices.title: Submission of Scholarship Applications for Academic Session 2026–27
notices.summary: NIT Hamirpur informed UG and PG students that the National Scholarship Portal had been opened by various Ministries for AY 2026–27 Fresh and Renewal applications and advised eligible students to apply within the timelines prescribed by the relevant Ministries.
notices.description: After online submission, the NIT notice asks students to submit the required hard copy and supporting documents to the Dean Student Welfare office for institute verification and processing. The notice does not provide one consolidated application closing date.
notices.publisher: Office of Dean (Student Welfare), NIT Hamirpur
notices.venue: Dean Student Welfare, NIT Hamirpur, for institute document verification/processing
notices.audience: NIT Hamirpur UG and PG students
notices.eligibility: Eligible UG and PG students; exact eligibility depends on the relevant scholarship scheme and Ministry.
uncertainties: The NIT notice says application timelines are prescribed separately by the respective Ministries; no universal closing date appears in the institute notice.
The NIT scholarships page still links the 2026-27 guidance, but this alone does not prove that every NSP scheme remains open on 2026-10-10.
Current state is therefore 'unknown' rather than 'ongoing'.

notices.title: Campus Recruitment 2026–27 — Recruiter Invitation
notices.summary: The Training and Placement Office, NIT Hamirpur is inviting organizations to participate in campus recruitment. Its official institutional account identifies the cycle as Campus Recruitment 2026–27 and directs organizations to a Job Application Form.
notices.description: Recruiter-facing opportunity associated with recruitment of NIT Hamirpur's 2027 graduating batch. No student application deadline or individual company drive schedule is published in the source used for this record.
notices.publisher: Training and Placement Office, NIT Hamirpur
notices.eligibility: Organizations seeking to recruit NIT Hamirpur students / Batch of 2027
uncertainties: The official account exposed the relevant update with a relative posting age rather than an exact publication date; no date has been inferred.
No overall closing date for the 2026-27 campus recruitment process was found.
This record is a recruiter-facing campus-recruitment invitation and should not be interpreted as a specific student job opening.
